verdict.rationale: Docs confirm alerting on any telemetry signal (NRQL-based alerts, threshold/anomaly detection) and explicit routing of issues to the correct team via notifications, backed by NerdGraph/CLI for configuration. However, the evidence pack never mentions grouping/deduplication of alerts into issues or silencing/muting rules, both core parts of this story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of alert grouping/correlation and muting/silencing rules, plus independent/hands-on corroboration of the full alerting workflow.
